heroLead: Sick, sad or struggling houseplant? Brown tips. Dropped leaves. Bugs you can't name. Bristol's houseplant hospital will diagnose, treat and revive it, from £8.

steps.title: Rescue
steps.body: Book a slot to drop off, or we can pick up. Free collection for 3 or more plants, BS1 to BS9.

steps.title: Revive
steps.body: Every plant is properly assessed and treated at the thrive Houseplant Hospital, from a quick repot to full pest treatment.

steps.title: Return
steps.body: Your plant comes back revived, with its own care card so you know what it needs to thrive.

symptomsIntro: If your plant is ticking any of these boxes, it's time for a check-up. Tap one to book in.

services.title: Houseplant Hospital
services.body: Diagnosis, repotting and pest treatment for plants that need a little help.

services.title: Pre-loved pots and plants
services.body: Healthy plants rehomed in second-hand ceramic pots. Each one is a one-off.

services.title: Offices and restaurants
services.body: Plants supplied and looked after, so your space stays green without the stress.

services.title: Gift vouchers
services.body: Know someone with a plant on its last legs? Give them a check-up.

patients.title: Snake plant
patients.note: Root rot. Trimmed, dried out and repotted in gritty mix.

patients.title: Lovely jade plant
patients.note: Mineral deposit build-up. Cleaned, flushed and fed.

patients.title: Calathea
patients.note: Crispy edges. A humidity plan and a new spot away from the radiator.

patients.title: A monster of a Monstera
patients.note: Rootbound. Divided, staked and back home.

aboutHeading: Bristol's first houseplant hospital, born in my back garden.
aboutBody: I've been helping revive friends' houseplants for decades, so a move to focus on plants wasn't that strange. If you need help with a plant, get in touch.
